questions.old_question: Which native fixture can retain and independently identify guest VMM/cgroup and disk across the release switch?
questions.answer: Fleet updates compare real Firecracker cgroup PID/start-time and guest traffic through release and credential updates. Dataset GUID and persistent disk challenge are present in other fleet paths but not integrated into upgrade; faulted switch absent.
